vsm2.14:153.5: cittacetasikānaṃ ajjhupekkhanabhāvena samappavattānaṃ ājānīyānaṃ ajjhupekkhakasārathi viya daṭṭhabbā.
vsm2.14:154.2: Kevalañhi tā appanāppattā rūpāvacarā, imā kāmāvacarāti ayameva viseso.
vsm2.14:154.3: Keci pana mettupekkhāyopi aniyatesu icchanti, taṃ na gahetabbaṃ.
vsm2.14:154.4: Atthato hi adosoyeva mettā, tatramajjhattupekkhāyeva upekkhāti.
vsm2.14:155.1: Kāyaduccaritato virati kāyaduccaritavirati. Esa nayo sesāsupi.
vsm2.14:155.2: Lakkhaṇādito panetā tissopi kāyaduccaritādivatthūnaṃ avītikkamalakkhaṇā, amaddanalakkhaṇāti vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm2.14:156.1: Iti imeva chattiṃsa saṅkhārā paṭhamena kāmāvacarakusalaviññāṇena sampayogaṃ gacchantīti veditabbā.
vsm2.14:156.2: Yathā ca paṭhamena, evaṃ dutiyenāpi. Sasaṅkhārabhāvamattameva hettha viseso.
vsm2.14:156.3: Tatiyena pana ṭhapetvā amohaṃ avasesā veditabbā.
vsm2.14:156.5: Paṭhame vuttesu pana ṭhapetvā pītiṃ avasesā pañcamena sampayogaṃ gacchanti.
vsm2.14:156.6: Yathā ca pañcamena, evaṃ chaṭṭhenāpi. Sasaṅkhārabhāvamattameva hettha viseso.
vsm2.14:156.7: Sattamena ca pana ṭhapetvā amohaṃ avasesā veditabbā.
vsm2.14:157.1: Paṭhame vuttesu ṭhapetvā viratittayaṃ sesā rūpāvacarakusalesu paṭhamena sampayogaṃ gacchanti.
vsm2.14:157.6: Teyeva catūsu āruppakusalesu. Arūpāvacarabhāvoyeva hi ettha viseso.
vsm2.14:158.1: Lokuttaresu paṭhamajjhānike tāva maggaviññāṇe paṭhamarūpāvacaraviññāṇe vuttanayena,
vsm2.14:158.3: Karuṇāmuditānaṃ pana abhāvo, niyataviratitā, lokuttaratā cāti ayamettha viseso.
vsm2.14:159.1: Akusalesu lobhamūle paṭhamākusalasampayuttā tāva niyatā sarūpena āgatā terasa, yevāpanakā cattāroti sattarasa.
vsm2.14:159.2: Tattha phasso, cetanā, vitakko, vicāro, pīti, vīriyaṃ, jīvitaṃ, samādhi, ahirikaṃ, anottappaṃ, lobho, moho, micchādiṭṭhīti ime sarūpena āgatā terasa (dha. sa. 365; dha. sa. aṭṭha. 365).
vsm2.14:159.3: Chando, adhimokkho, uddhaccaṃ, manasikāroti ime yevāpanakā cattāro (dha. sa. aṭṭha. 365).
vsm2.14:160.1: Tattha na hiriyatīti ahiriko. Ahirikassa bhāvo ahirikaṃ.
vsm2.14:160.3: Tesu ahirikaṃ kāyaduccaritādīhi ajigucchanalakkhaṇaṃ, alajjālakkhaṇaṃ vā.
vsm2.14:161.1: Lubbhanti tena, sayaṃ vā lubbhati, lubbhanamattameva vā tanti lobho.
vsm2.14:161.2: Muyhanti tena, sayaṃ vā muyhati, muyhanamattameva vā tanti moho.
vsm2.14:162.5: Taṇhānadībhāvena vaḍḍhamāno sīghasotā nadī iva mahāsamuddaṃ apāyameva gahetvā gacchatīti daṭṭhabbo.
vsm2.14:164.1: Micchā passanti tāya, sayaṃ vā micchā passati, micchādassanamattaṃ vā esāti micchādiṭṭhi.
vsm2.14:166.1: Sesā kusale vuttanayeneva veditabbā. Akusalabhāvoyeva hi akusalabhāvena ca lāmakattaṃ etesaṃ tehi viseso.
vsm2.14:166.2: Iti ime sattarasa saṅkhārā paṭhamena akusalaviññāṇena sampayogaṃ gacchantīti veditabbā.
vsm2.14:166.3: Yathā ca paṭhamena, evaṃ dutiyenāpi. Sasaṅkhāratā panettha thinamiddhassa ca aniyatatā viseso.
vsm2.14:168.1: Tatiyena paṭhame vuttesu ṭhapetvā micchādiṭṭhiṃ avasesā veditabbā.
vsm2.14:168.2: Māno panettha aniyato hoti. Ayaṃ viseso,
vsm2.14:168.8: Catutthena dutiye vuttesu ṭhapetvā micchādiṭṭhiṃ avasesā veditabbā. Etthāpi ca māno aniyatesu hotiyeva.
vsm2.14:169.1: Paṭhame vuttesu pana ṭhapetvā pītiṃ avasesā pañcamena sampayogaṃ gacchanti.
vsm2.14:169.2: Yathā ca pañcamena, evaṃ chaṭṭhenāpi. Sasaṅkhāratā panettha thinamiddhassa ca aniyatabhāvo viseso.
vsm2.14:169.3: Sattamena pañcame vuttesu ṭhapetvā diṭṭhiṃ avasesā veditabbā. Māno panettha aniyato hoti.
vsm2.14:169.4: Aṭṭhamena chaṭṭhe vuttesu ṭhapetvā diṭṭhiṃ avasesā veditabbā. Etthāpi ca māno aniyatesu hotiyevāti.
vsm2.14:170.1: Dosamūlesu pana dvīsu paṭhamasampayuttā tāva niyatā sarūpena āgatā ekādasa, yevāpanakā cattāro, aniyatā tayoti aṭṭhārasa.
vsm2.14:170.2: Tattha phasso, cetanā, vitakko, vicāro, vīriyaṃ, jīvitaṃ, samādhi, ahirikaṃ, anoppattaṃ, doso, mohoti ime sarūpena āgatā ekādasa (dha. sa. 413; dha. sa. aṭṭha. 413).
vsm2.14:170.3: Chando, adhimokkho, uddhaccaṃ, manasikāroti ime yevāpanakā cattāro (dha. sa. aṭṭha. 413).
vsm2.14:170.4: Issā, macchariyaṃ, kukkuccanti ime aniyatā tayo (dha. sa. aṭṭha. 413).
vsm2.14:171.1: Tattha dussanti tena, sayaṃ vā dussati, dussanamattameva vā tanti doso.
vsm2.14:171.3: visappanaraso visanipāto viya, attano nissayadahanaraso vā dāvaggi viya.
vsm2.14:173.2: Taṃ laddhānaṃ vā labhitabbānaṃ vā attano sampattīnaṃ nigūhanalakkhaṇaṃ,
vsm2.14:174.1: Kucchitaṃ kataṃ kukataṃ. Tassa bhāvo kukkuccaṃ.
vsm2.14:175.2: Iti ime aṭṭhārasa saṅkhārā paṭhamena dosamūlena sampayogaṃ gacchantīti veditabbā.
vsm2.14:175.3: Yathā ca paṭhamena, evaṃ dutiyenāpi. Sasaṅkhāratā pana aniyatesu ca thinamiddhasambhavova viseso.
vsm2.14:176.1: Mohamūlesu dvīsu vicikicchāsampayuttena tāva phasso, cetanā, vitakko, vicāro, vīriyaṃ, jīvitaṃ, cittaṭṭhiti, ahirikaṃ, anottappaṃ, moho, vicikicchāti sarūpena āgatā ekādasa (dha. sa. 422; dha. sa. aṭṭha. 422),
vsm2.14:176.2: uddhaccaṃ, manasikāroti yevāpanakā dve cāti terasa.
vsm2.14:178.1: Uddhaccasampayuttena vicikicchāsampayutte vuttesu ṭhapetvā vicikicchaṃ sesā dvādasa.
vsm2.14:178.3: Tena saddhiṃ teraseva, adhimokkhasabbhāvato ca balavataro samādhi hoti.
vsm2.14:179.3: Tattha kusalākusalavipākacakkhuviññāṇasampayuttā tāva phasso, cetanā, jīvitaṃ, cittaṭṭhitīti sarūpena āgatā cattāro (dha. sa. 431; dha. sa. aṭṭha. 431), yevāpanako manasikāroyevāti pañca.
vsm2.14:180.1: Ubhayavipākamanodhātuyā ete ceva vitakkavicārādhimokkhā cāti aṭṭha, tathā tividhāyapi ahetukamanoviññāṇadhātuyā.
vsm2.14:180.2: Yā panettha somanassasahagatā, tāya saddhiṃ pīti adhikā hotīti veditabbā.
vsm2.14:181.2: Tesu aṭṭhakāmāvacaravipākasampayuttā tāva aṭṭhahi kāmāvacarakusalehi sampayuttasaṅkhārasadisāyeva.
vsm2.14:181.3: Yā pana tā aniyatesu karuṇāmuditā, tā sattārammaṇattā vipākesu na santi. Ekantaparittārammaṇā hi kāmāvacaravipākā.
vsm2.14:181.4: Na kevalañca karuṇāmuditā, viratiyopi vipākesu na santi.
